note: ECA Webform provides (1) one derived ECA event plugin, base id 'webform', with 25 derivatives 'webform:<hook>' (e.g. webform:submission_form_alter, webform:submission_access, webform:element_alter, webform:options_alter, webform:access_rules) mirroring Webform's alter/access hooks and exposing args as [webform:*] tokens; and (2) four core #[Action] plugins: eca_webform_submission_get_data and eca_webform_submission_set_data (type webform_submission; keys field_name + token_name/field_value) and eca_webform_get_third_party_setting / eca_webform_set_third_party_setting (type webform; keys provider, setting_name, token_name/setting_value). No configure route, permissions, or Drush. Usage is entirely within ECA models (eca.eca.<id> config entities), so medium cases read back a seeded model's action plugin/config, and hard cases build an ECA model referencing an eca_webform action or event (verified on the live eca config entity). An ECA model with empty events still saves and preserves its actions, which the get-data verify relies on.

evals.prompt: Using the eca_webform module, I want to start an ECA model when a webform submission form is being built (the submission_form_alter hook). What is the ECA event plugin id I select, and what is the base plugin id that all eca_webform events derive from?
evals.expected_output: The event plugin id is webform:submission_form_alter. All eca_webform events derive from the single base plugin id 'webform' (derivative id = 'webform:' + hook key), one derivative per Webform hook.

evals.prompt: In an ECA model reacting to a webform submission, which eca_webform action reads a submitted element value into an ECA token, and which two configuration keys does it take (one for the element, one for the destination token)?
evals.expected_output: The action is eca_webform_submission_get_data (type webform_submission). It takes field_name (the element machine name to read via getElementData()) and token_name (the ECA token the value is written into). Both are token-aware.

evals.prompt: eca_webform also ships actions to read and write a webform's third-party settings. Name the two action plugin ids and the object type they operate on, and list their configuration keys.
evals.expected_output: eca_webform_get_third_party_setting and eca_webform_set_third_party_setting, both of type 'webform'. Common keys provider and setting_name; get- adds token_name (destination token), set- adds setting_value (the value to store).

evals.prompt: This site has an ECA model with machine name ecawf_known that contains a single eca_webform action. Inspect the live ECA configuration and state the action's plugin id.
evals.expected_output: The ecawf_known model's action uses plugin eca_webform_submission_set_data (readable from the eca.eca.ecawf_known config entity actions, e.g. $eca->get('actions')['act_set']['plugin']).

evals.prompt: An ECA model named ecawf_field on this site uses an eca_webform 'Get submission data' action. Inspect the live configuration and state the token name (token_name) that the action writes the read value into.
evals.expected_output: The get-data action in ecawf_field has token_name = submitted_email (in the action's configuration inside eca.eca.ecawf_field; it reads element field_name=email).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, create an ECA model with machine name ecawf_task that includes an eca_webform 'Get submission data' action (plugin eca_webform_submission_get_data), configured with a field_name (an element machine name) and a token_name for the result. Save the model to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An eca.eca.ecawf_task config entity exists whose actions include one with plugin=eca_webform_submission_get_data (with field_name and token_name in its configuration). Create it via the eca storage, e.g. \Drupal::entityTypeManager()->getStorage('eca')->create([...])->save().

evals.prompt: Create an ECA model with machine name ecawf_task2 that is triggered by the eca_webform submission-form-alter event (event plugin webform:submission_form_alter), and save it to the live site.
evals.expected_output: An eca.eca.ecawf_task2 config entity whose events include one with plugin=webform:submission_form_alter (the base plugin is 'webform', derivative 'submission_form_alter').
